name: dismantle-above-uplimit
summary: Karis dismantle accepts an item enchanted above its ItemInfo.UpLimit (a lowered enchant cap) instead of refusing it with 'Upgrade Info Error' (0x1687).
why: ShinePlayer::sp_NC_ITEM_DISMANTLE_REQ 0x5293C0 reads the cell's upgrade level (+N) into [ebp-0x21A5]
(0x5295CD..0x5295F6, record +0xA or +0x12 by item class), checks the ItemInfo row (Class 4..8 at +0x66, UpLimit
0x529680   movzx ecx, cl; push ecx; GetRecord(+N) on the dismantle table 0x13295968
With stock data an item can never be above its UpLimit (enchanting stops there), so the branch never fires.
Fiesta2026on2016 Rebalanced 0017-enchant-caps LOWERS UpLimit (e.g. Moon Rouemen Staff 10 -> 6) and owned items
keep their level: the operator's +9 staff (item 14514, 2026-09-25 17:21 bridge log: 0x302A {slot 114} -> 0x302B
0x1687) could not be dismantled. The lookup that follows is by +N (<= 12, the zone's enchant maximum), which works
for any real item, so the branch is removed: `jb rel32` (0F 82 CE 01 00 00) -> a 6-byte NOP (66 0F 1F 44 00 00).
Parity behaviour is unchanged (the branch was unreachable there).
